text.p: Following are the main stories from Austrian newspapers on Monday.
- Investment boom in the wake of Austria's EU entry 2-1/2 years ago. Austrian firms have taken the opportunity to increase investment abroad.
- The ATX index is in top form. The Vienna stock exchange is finally keeping pace with rises on foreign markets
- The coalition government intends to stand firm on pension reform plans. Pressure on civil servants is increasing.
- Today is decisive for government pension reform plans in the public sector. Union boss Neugebauer says his members will not allow themselves to be pressured.
- Savings bank Tiroler Sparkasse is negotiating a sale to German and Italian banks, according to chief executive Wunderbaldinger. Partner expected by end August.
- Interview with Transport Minister Einem about his telecoms strategy.
